timing_scope: GPU timestep split into source, velocity advection, buoyancy, divergence, pressure clear/setup, Jacobi solve, pressure-gradient subtraction and scalar advection; excludes reset, readback, rendering, CPU diagnostics and file output
numerical_diagnostics: single-group float32 GPU reductions over fluid cells; divergence before/after projection and cell-centred velocity energy; executed after solver timestamp
readback: density during benchmark and compact numerical diagnostics every step after timestamp; may affect total frame cost
comparison_note: CPU PCG and fixed-iteration GPU Jacobi do not guarantee equal projection accuracy. Deterministic schedule, not cross-device bitwise determinism.
